text: Add feature to capture the MP3 audio from a meeting that has already happened along with the transcript as a flag or configuration driven option in the transcript retrieval/capture workflow.

DEFERRED SCOPE EXPANSION. Expansion: make the direct-exec headed browser launcher (launchCleanHeadedBrowser / cleanBrowserArgs in internal/browser/recap.go) honor the same TEAMS_DISABLE_SANDBOX / Options.DisableSandbox opt-in so join --headed can start Chromium in root or container environments. Out of scope per P-021 C1: 013.003-T authorized only the chromedp allocator flag emitters (StealthFlags and cleanHeadlessFlags); the direct-exec launcher is a different contract surface that never emitted sandbox-disabling flags and whose tests assert it must not, so this adds a new launch-path capability rather than completing the authorized change. Source refs: task 013.003-T, feature 013-F, shipment 013-S, PR 33, review-thread PRRT_kwDOTStvas62BKaF. Requires deliberation: yes (whether the direct launcher should ever accept a sandbox opt-out). Kind: task. Provisional priority: medium.

DEFERRED SCOPE EXPANSION.
